title: Trust the GPU
why: A service saying “unloaded” is a claim. Free memory on the card is a fact. An eviction counts only when the GPU's free memory has risen by at least half of what the model held.

d.reason: evicting ollama-rtx4060/qwen3:8b on rtx4060 for 4380 MB

beats.title: Eight gigabytes, all spoken for
beats.text: On the RTX 4060, Ollama still holds a language model nobody has used for 22 minutes, XTTS is speaking, and Whisper is loaded. A chat request now needs a different model.

beats.title: Pick the fewest, idlest victims
beats.text: The request is 4.3 GB short. XTTS is busy, so it is never touched. The idle qwen3:8b alone covers it, so Whisper stays loaded too.

beats.title: The service says it is gone. The GPU disagrees.
beats.text: Ollama has already dropped qwen3 from its list, but NVML still shows 4.5 GB held. Granting now would run straight into an out-of-memory error, so the request stays queued.

beats.title: Confirmed by the GPU, then granted
beats.text: After 6.3 seconds the card's free memory really rises. Only then does the chat request get its lease.

beats.title: The model stays for the next request
beats.text: The lease ends, but gemma3 stays loaded until something needs the room. With no idle rule set for it, iris evicts a model only to make room.
